research.credit: Nunuhara Cabbage; format reverse engineering SLC; MT19937 Matsumoto/Nishimura

scope: First-class safe Rust AIN v5 VM/heap, worker execution and thin shared host mappings. SACT2 logical Init materializes shared hidden main Canvas/Layer and checks published fonts/audio services. No complete SACT HLL, sprite renderer, playable factory, original saves or serialized native snapshots.

native: AIN encoding, operands and byte PCs
i32/f32 bit values, heap slot identity/reference count/sequence and typed pages
native calls, argument transfer, variable references, constructor/destructor continuation
reviewed OutputLog.dll absent Windows debug-interface policy
SACT2 main-surface number and logical canvas metadata; repeated-init and typed HLL completion
S_MOD native value kinds, argument ownership and original string-slot release policy
shared: crysirror-resource legacy MT19937-1998 envelope decode and capability read_all
crysirror-core client storage and HostServices.now_ms; VmYield deadline
crysirror-scene Canvas/Layer transactional main resource and background state
crysirror-core scoped FontLibrary/TextMeasurement and ChannelAudio readiness
crysirror-text::format bounded first-compatible byte formatting independent of VM and fonts
not_imported: xsystem4 C runtime or FFI engine

static_abi_evidence.condition: Create first calls GetModuleHandleA("DPLogViewer.ade"), then GetProcAddress("GetInterface") and GUID interface lookup. Absent loaded module/interface returns -1 at VA0x10001056. Native host provides no such Windows module. No original code is executed.
static_abi_evidence.proof_limits: DLL hash guard restricts this branch to reviewed ABI. Connected interface/native logging resources are unsupported; no arbitrary DLL or unknown export can silently succeed.

sact_profile.logical_canvas: explicit Config.canvas from original view configuration, never DisplayInfo physical pixels
sact_profile.fonts: explicit Gothic/Mincho aliases must already be published by shared font jobs; portable aliases do not claim original Windows font import
sact_profile.audio: existing shared device-free channel service; no original SDL mixer or fake prepared voice
sact_profile.init: original main surface -1, opaque black, hidden; original same-engine repeat returns1 without reinitialization

string_format_profile.encoding: ASCII syntax, surrounding and string payload bytes unchanged; width counts encoded bytes
string_format_profile.bounds: template/output <=1MiB, numeric width/precision <=510; unknown syntax, unimplemented compatible conversion and template NUL fail before VM mutation
string_format_profile.value_nul: %s uses val->size and string_append memcpy, preserving embedded NUL; it is not strlen
string_format_profile.precision: integer and string precision parsed but ignored; string zero-pad ignored
